capabilities: add a copy icon to the note's action bar
copy the entire Markdown text of the note to the clipboard
confirm the copy with a notification
run a copy-all command from the command palette
assign a hotkey to the copy command
extras: README is written in Portuguese. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; before official directory approval it can be installed via BRAT from the author's GitHub repository, or manually by copying main.js and manifest.json into the vault. MIT licensed.
problem: Obsidian has no one-click way to copy a note's entire text; you must open the note, select all, and copy manually.

relations.evidence: pode instalar o plugin BRAT e adicionar o teu repositório

summary: Action-bar utility that adds a copy icon to each note and copies the note's full Markdown text to the clipboard with one click.
